U.note: Calm, clear light design with AC/C toggle, active-operator highlight, shrinking digits, aria-live and full keyboard; correct on all cases, code a bit tangled.

V.note: Standard iOS-style dark calculator with commas and correct results, but sparse aria labels (symbol-only buttons) and a plain, generic look.

W.note: Polished dark glass look with labelled buttons, C/CE/backspace and a keyboard hint; a little extra chrome and longer source.

X.note: Leanest and most basic, correct, but flat styling, no backspace key on screen, minimal aria labels, and a dead AC ternary.

Y.note: Warm, legible light theme with strong display contrast, C/CE/backspace, helpful error caption, good aria labels and phone fit, in tidy code.

Z.note: Gorgeous seven-segment retro calculator and arithmetic is sound with repeat-equals, but it is overbuilt for 'basic' and the large SVG-drawing source is heavy.
